Final assembly is one printed knob plus one nut.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_thickness":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_diameter":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_diameter":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_diameter":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_thickness":{"value":2.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_af_allowance":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bore_allowance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"nut_axial_play":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"entry_ramp_height":{"value":1.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_thickness":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_width":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_gap":{"value":0.7,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_projection":{"value":0.45,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_count":{"value":6,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_radius":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_center_radius":{"value":16.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    af = p.nut_af + p.pocket_af_allowance
    f = af/2
    zs = p.floor_thickness
    zl = zs+p.nut_thickness+p.nut_axial_play
    h = zl+p.entry_ramp_height
    b = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_diameter/2).extrude(h)
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_count)):
        a = 2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_count
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.scallop_center_radius*math.cos(a),p.scallop_center_radius*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_radius).extrude(h))
    r = af/math.sqrt(3)
    pts = [(r*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),r*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=zs).polyline(pts).close().extrude(h-zs))
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_diameter+p.bore_allowance)/2).extrude(h))
    for s in (-1,1):
        x0 = f-p.lip_projection
        x1 = f+p.tab_thickness+p.tab_gap
        for sy in (-1,1):
            b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=zs).center(s*(x0+x1)/2,sy*(p.tab_width+p.tab_gap)/2).rect(x1-x0,p.tab_gap).extrude(h-zs))
        b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=zs).center(s*(f+p.tab_thickness+p.tab_gap/2),0).rect(p.tab_gap,p.tab_width+2*p.tab_gap).extrude(h-zs))
        lip = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(s*f,zl),(s*(f-p.lip_projection),zl),(s*f,h)]).close().extrude(p.tab_width/2,both=True)
        b = b.union(lip)
    return b.clean()
